tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground, carrying the dot grid. Espresso walnut at night, cream by day — never pure black or white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid panels: sidebars, the board column, modals behind glass.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus and anything that must stay opaque.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of floating glass: cards, icon tiles, the agent panel. Always with backdrop blur and glass-edge.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass on hover, or glass that holds a lot of text.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of every glass surface. Decorative — a glass control also needs its text and focus ring to carry it.

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: The 1px top highlight inside glass (inset shadow), so it reads as a lit pane.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and the dots of the background grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and unfilled path nodes. 3:1+ on void and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: walnut
tokens.usage: Wood — the people realm. Illustration, the cover, Prairie rules on hearth cards, large shapes. Never text; never a state. 3:1+ on hearth in both themes.

tokens.name: hearth
tokens.usage: The people realm: the warm, wood-toned ground of anything a person made — idea cards, profiles, quotes, comments. ink, ink-muted, signal-text and pollen-text read on it.

tokens.name: hearth-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of hearth surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on void, surface, surface-raised, glass and every -wash. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, mono context lines on void, surface, surface-raised and glass.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Tomato — the people realm's ember. The human moment: the one primary action, the agent's ask for YOU, the 'now' step. Fill and marks; text on it is on-bright.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Signal-coloured text and links on void, surface, glass and signal-wash.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for asks and 'needs you' chips; ink or signal-text on it.

tokens.name: ion
tokens.usage: Atomic teal — the agent realm. Its presence dot, its activity, things it captured or drafted. Fill and marks; on-bright text on it.

tokens.name: ion-text
tokens.usage: The agent's name and agent-written labels on void, surface, glass and ion-wash.

tokens.name: ion-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for agent chips ('drafted', 'captured').

tokens.name: pollen
tokens.usage: Mustard — the people realm's lamplight. Ideas: a newly captured idea, a highlight, your vote; the people's lamp and the organization's moon. Fill and marks; on-bright text on it. Too light for marks alone on Day void — pair it with ink or a darker hue.

tokens.name: pollen-text
tokens.usage: Idea-coloured text on void, surface, glass and pollen-wash.

tokens.name: pollen-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for 'new idea' chips and idea highlights.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Avocado — the organization realm. Momentum: agreement, credit earned, ratified, done. Fill and marks.

tokens.name: moss-text
tokens.usage: Agreement counts and credit on void, surface, glass and moss-wash.

tokens.name: moss-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for agreement and 'done' chips.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Powder blue — the organization realm's sky. Initiatives, votes in progress, open questions. Fill and marks.

tokens.name: tide-text
tokens.usage: Question and vote labels on void, surface, glass and tide-wash.

tokens.name: tide-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for 'needs confirm' and 'vote open' chips.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal, ion, pollen and moss fills, both themes (5:1+).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, the empty board. Schibsted Grotesk 600, tight — the same face the wordmark is drawn from.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: an initiative, a project.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles, task titles, the agent's ask.

styles.name: idea
styles.sample: What if the warehouse crew picked the schedule?
styles.usage: A member's idea, in their own words. People speak in serif.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up anything that fits your week. Rough is fine.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: The agent's voice: provenance, context, timestamps, points. The machine speaks in mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between stacked metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical); gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; the background dot-grid pitch; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, glass icon tiles, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and glass panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The agent panel and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, presence dots, path nodes.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Every floating glass surface: a lit top edge and a soft drop well below.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Glass on hover or while dragged.

tokens.name: halo-signal
tokens.usage: Coloured light under a signal icon or the primary button — it floats over its own glow.

tokens.name: halo-ion
tokens.usage: Under the agent's icon and presence.

tokens.name: halo-pollen
tokens.usage: Under idea icons.

tokens.name: halo-moss
tokens.usage: Under credit and done icons.

tokens.name: halo-tide
tokens.usage: Under vote and question icons.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for glass surfaces (with saturate 140%).

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: Print grain over large grounds (in-tex--grain). Felt, not seen.

tokens.name: opacity-texture
tokens.usage: Starfield, orbit and weave textures (in-tex--stars, --orbits, --weave), painted in line (orbits, weave) and ink-muted (stars).
